headline: Built properly,
inside and out.
copy.sub: Building work, brickwork, renovations and landscaping across Hertfordshire. Rated 5.0 on Google, with the groundwork done right so it lasts.
copy.about_alt: A finished patio, lawn and fencing lit up at night behind a brick house
copy.lede: From brick walls and renovations to full outdoor builds, Lewis and his team do the hard part properly: solid ground preparation, a proper sub-base and a neat finish. Customers say you can tell no corners were cut.

services.title: Brickwork and walls
services.blurb: Garden walls, block walls, piers and repointing, laid on proper footings.
services.intro: Walls built on proper footings so they stay straight for years.

services.title: Renovations and interiors
services.blurb: Bathrooms, room refits and general building work inside the house.
services.intro: Inside work finished to the same standard as the outside.

services.title: Patios and paving
services.blurb: Sandstone and porcelain patios with full ground prep, a solid sub-base and neat pointing.
services.intro: Every patio starts with the dig-out and sub-base, the part most people skip.

services.title: Groundworks and driveways
services.blurb: Excavation, drainage, bases and driveways, prepared properly.
services.intro: Get the ground right and everything on top of it lasts.

services.title: Fencing and garden structures
services.blurb: Slatted and close-board fencing, pergolas, sleeper beds and lighting.
services.intro: Built to stand up to the weather, with posts set properly.

services.title: Full garden builds
services.blurb: Complete transformations: walls, patio, turf, fencing and lighting, start to finish.
services.intro: One team for the whole job, from clearing the site to the last light.

gallery: Full garden build, lit at night
faqs: Do you do building work as well as gardens?
